title: Reading music, fakers and Lawrence Welk
summary: He says Brunies was a jobbing faker who could not read charts, and compares a similar case where a good jazz player could not hold a place in Welk's band.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear
